verses.en: Also I in the first year of Darius the Mede, even I, stood to confirm and to strengthen him.
verses.sm: O le malo o Peresia, atoa ma isi malo O aʻu foi, na aʻu tu atu i le tausaga muamua o Tariu le Metai, e fesoasoani ma faamalosi ia te ia.

verses.en: And now will I shew thee the truth. Behold, there shall stand up yet three kings in Persia; and the fourth shall be far richer than they all: and by his strength through his riches he shall stir up all against the realm of Grecia.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, ou te faaali atu ia te oe le upu moni. Faauta, e toe tutú mai tupu o Peresia e toatolu, a o lona toafa e sili lava ia ona mauoa ia te i latou uma; o lona malosi foi, e maua i lona oloa, na te lagaina mai ai i latou uma e tau ma le malo o [avana.

verses.en: And a mighty king shall stand up, that shall rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.
verses.sm: E tulai foi le tupu lima malosi, e pule lava ia i malo e tele, ma fai mea na te loto i ai.

verses.en: And when he shall stand up, his kingdom shall be broken, and shall be divided toward the four winds of heaven; and not to his posterity, nor according to his dominion which he ruled: for his kingdom shall be plucked up, even for others beside those.
verses.sm: A 00 ina tulai o ia, ona lepetia lea o lona malo, ma vaevaeina i matagi e fa o le lagi, a e le fai ma ana fanau, e le tusa foi ma lana pule e pule ai o ia; aua e liaiina lona malo, e fai foi mo nisi a e le o i latou.

verses.en: And the king of the south shall be strong, and one of his princes; and he shall be strong above him, and have dominion; his dominion shall be a great dominion.
verses.sm: E malosi foi le tupu o le itu i toga, ma le tasi alii e ia te ia; e sili foi lona malosi i lona, e pule foi ia; o lana pule, o le pule tele lea.

verses.en: And in the end of years they shall join themselves together; for the king's daughter of the south shall come to the king of the north to make an agreement: but she shall not retain the power of the arm; neither shall he stand, nor his arm: but she shall be given up, and they that brought her, and he that begat her, and he that strengthened her in these times.
verses.sm: A oo i le tuluiga o tausaga, la te sosoo faatasi; aua o le afafine o le tupu o le itu i toga e sau o ia i le tupuo le itu i matu e fai ai se leleiga; a e le tumau ia te ia le lima malosi, e le tumau foi o ia, po o lona malosi; a e tuuina atu o ia, atoa ma i latou e molia o ia, ma lē fanaua e ia, atoa ma le na te faamalosia o ia i ia ona po.

verses.en: But out of a branch of her roots shall one stand up in his estate, which shall come with an army, and shall enter into the fortress of the king of the north, and shall deal against them, and shall prevail:
verses.sm: Ao le tátupu o ona aa e tu mai ai se tasi i lana nofoaiga, e sau foi o ia ma ‘au, ma alu atu i le ‘olo o le tupu o le itui matu, e fai lona loto ia te i latou ma manumalo ai.

verses.en: And shall also carry captives into Egypt their gods, with their princes, and with their precious vessels of silver and of gold; and he shall continue more years than the king of the north.
verses.sm: Na te avea foi faatagataotaua i Aikupito o latou atua, ma o latou alii, atoa ma o latou IPU manaomia O ario ma auro; e tumau foi o ia i tausaga e sili i tausaga o le tupu o le itu i matu.

verses.en: So the king of the south shall come into his kingdom, and shall return into his own land.
verses.sm: E alu atu foio ia i le malo o le tupu o le itu i toga, ma toe foi i lona lava nuu.

verses.en: But his sons shall be stirred up, and shall assemble a multitude of great forces: and one shall certainly come, and overflow, and pass through: then shall he return, and be stirred up, even to his fortress.
verses.sm: to A o ona atalii la te laga mai, ma la faapotopoto le vao “au e tele; ona matuá sau ai lea o le tasi, e lofia ai e ia le nuu ma ui ane ai; ona toe laga mai lea o ia e oo i lona ‘olo.

verses.en: And the king of the south shall be moved with choler, and shall come forth and fight with him, even with the king of the north: and he shall set forth a great multitude; but the multitude shall be given into his hand.
verses.sm: E matua ita foi le tupu o le itu i toga, ona alu atu lea o ia la te tau ma le tupu o le itu i matu; na te aveina atu “au e tele lava; a e tuuina atu i lana pule le vao “au e tele.

verses.en: And when he hath taken away the multitude, his heart shall be lifted up; and he shall cast down many ten thousands: but he shall not be strengthened by it.
verses.sm: A aveesea foi ia “au e tele ona faamaualugaina ai lea o lona loto; e manomano foi o e lafotuina e ia, a e le malosi ai o ia.

verses.en: For the king of the north shall return, and shall set forth a multitude greater than the former, and shall certainly come after certain years with a great army and with much riches.
verses.sm: Aua e toe foi mai le tupu o le itu i matu, na te aveina atu ‘au e sili ona tele ie na muamua; a mavae isi tausaga e sau ai lava o ia ma “au e tele, atoa ma le oloa tele.

verses.en: And in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south: also the robbers of thy people shall exalt themselves to establish the vision; but they shall fall.
verses.sm: O ia ona po foi e toatele latou te tutù atu e tetee atu i le tupu o le itu i toga; e faamaualuga foi tagata e i lou nuu, latou te faataunuu ai le faaaliga, a e pauu i latou.

verses.en: So the king of the north shall come, and cast up a mount, and take the most fenced cities: and the arms of the south shall not withstand, neither his chosen people, neither shall there be any strength to withstand.
verses.sm: Ona sau ai lea o le tupu o le itu i matu, e tanu e ia se mea maupuepue, na te aea aai nofo‘olo; o “au foi a le itu i toga, atoa ma ona tagata ua filifilia latou te le tetee atu, e leai lava se malosi e tetee atu ai.

verses.en: But he that cometh against him shall do according to his own will, and none shall stand before him: and he shall stand in the glorious land, which by his hand shall be consumed.
verses.sm: O lē alu atu ia te ia na te faia mea ua ia loto i ai, e leai foi se tasi e tu i ona luma; e tu lava ia i le nuu matagofie, e faaumaina foi i lona lima.

verses.en: He shall also set his face to enter with the strength of his whole kingdom, and upright ones with him; thus shall he do: and he shall give him the daughter of women, corrupting her: but she shall not stand on his side, neither be for him.
verses.sm: E faasaga foi o ia ina ia alu atu ma le ‘au tau o lona malo uma, e faatasi foi ma ia e amiotonu, ma na faia lava; na te avatu foi ia te ia le teine muli ina ia leaga ai le loto o le teine; a ele tumau ai o ia, e le ‘au faatasi foi ma ia.

verses.en: After this shall he turn his face unto the isles, and shall take many: but a prince for his own behalf shall cause the reproach offered by him to cease; without his own reproach he shall cause it to turn upon him.
verses.sm: Ona faasaga lea o ia i nuu tu tai, ma na faoa nuu e tele; a o le tasi alii na te faaiuina e ia lona gao; na te faaliliu atu foi ia te ia lea mea, a e le gaogaoina ai o ia.

verses.en: Then he shall turn his face toward the fort of his own land: but he shall stumble and fall, and not be found.
verses.sm: Ona toe faasaga lea o ia i le ‘olo o lona nuu; a e tausuai o ia ma pati, e le toe iloa foi o ia.

verses.en: Then shall stand up in his estate a raiser of taxes in the glory of the kingdom: but within few days he shall be destroyed, neither in anger, nor in battle.
verses.sm: A e tu mai se tasi i lana nofoaiga, o le na te faaui ane le faau taulaga i le nuu matagofie o lona malo; a E mavae nai aso ona fano ai lea o ia, ae le o se ita po o se taua.

verses.en: And in his estate shall stand up a vile person, to whom they shall not give the honour of the kingdom: but he shall come in peaceably, and obtain the kingdom by flatteries.
verses.sm: Ona tu mai lea i lana nofoaiga o le e inosia, latou te le tuuina atu ia te ia le mamalu o le malo; a e sau faafifilemu ia, o faaoleolega foi na te maua mai ai le malo.

verses.en: And with the arms of a flood shall they be overflown from before him, and shall be broken; yea, also the prince of the covenant.
verses.sm: O “au foi a e lolofi mai e lofia ai i latou mai ona luma, e faaumatia ai i latou, atoa ma le alii o le feagaiga.

verses.en: And after the league made with him he shall work deceitfully: for he shall come up, and shall become strong with a small people.
verses.sm: A uma foi ona sosoo ma ia, e fai mea pepelo lava ia; aua e alu ae lava ia, o se nuu itiiti foi e malosi ai o ia.

verses.en: He shall enter peaceably even upon the fattest places of the province; and he shall do that which his fathers have not done, nor his fathers' fathers; he shall scatter among them the prey, and spoil, and riches: yea, and he shall forecast his devices against the strong holds, even for a time.
verses.sm: E alu atu o ia ma le fifilemu i mea e sili ona lelei o le itu malo; na te faia foi mea na le faia e ona tama, po O tama o ona tama; na te tufatufaina ia te i latou o mea faoa, ma vete, atoa ma oloa, na te taumafaufau i lona loto e aea ai ‘olo, seia oo i se aso.

verses.en: And he shall stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south shall be stirred up to battle with a very great and mighty army; but he shall not stand: for they shall forecast devices against him.
verses.sm: E faamalosi atu foi o ia ma lona loto atoa e tau ma le tupu o le itu i toga, ma le itu taua e toatele; o le tupu foi o le itu i toga e laga mai o ia i le taua, ma le itu taua tele ma le malosi tele lava; a e le tumau o ia, aua latou te taupulepule ia te ia.

verses.en: Yea, they that feed of the portion of his meat shall destroy him, and his army shall overflow: and many shall fall down slain.
verses.sm: O e aaii ana mea taumafa, e fano ai o ia, e lolofi mai foi ana ‘au; e toatele foi e fasiotia.

verses.en: And both these kings' hearts shall be to do mischief, and they shall speak lies at one table; but it shall not prosper: for yet the end shall be at the time appointed.
verses.sm: E finagalo ia tupu e lua e fai mea leaga, la te tala pepelo i le laoai e tasi; a e le manuia ai, aua e oo lava le iuga i ona po ua atofaina ai.

verses.en: Then shall he return into his land with great riches; and his heart shall be against the holy covenant; and he shall do exploits, and return to his own land.
verses.sm: Ona toe foi ai lea o ia i lona nuu male oloa tele; e ita foi o ia i le feagaiga paia; na te faia foi lona loto, ona toe foi lea o 1a i lona nuu.

verses.en: At the time appointed he shall return, and come toward the south; but it shall not be as the former, or as the latter.
verses.sm: O ona po ua tuupoina e toe foi mai ai o ia, ma alu atu i le itu i toga; a e le iu faapei o le na muamua, po o lé mulimuli.

verses.en: For the ships of Chittim shall come against him: therefore he shall be grieved, and return, and have indignation against the holy covenant: so shall he do; he shall even return, and have intelligence with them that forsake the holy covenant.
verses.sm: Aua e alu atu le fua a Kitimo e tetee atu ia te ia; e tigaina ai lona loto, ona toe foi mai ai lea, e ita atu foi o ia i le feagaiga paia; na te faapea. lava ona fai, na te toe foi mai ma faasaga lona manatu i e ua lafoai le feagaiga paia.

verses.en: And arms shall stand on his part, and they shall pollute the sanctuary of strength, and shall take away the daily sacrifice, and they shall place the abomination that maketh desolate.
verses.sm: O ‘au foi latou te ‘au ma ia, latou te faaleagaina le malumalu e malu ai, latou te aveeseina foi le taulaga fai soo, ma tuuina ai le mea inosia e faatafunaina ai.

verses.en: And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries: but the people that do know their God shall be strong, and do exploits.
verses.sm: O e agasala i le feagaiga e leaga i latou ia te ia i faaoleolega; a o le nuu o e ua iloa lo latou Atua latou te faamalolosi ma fai mea tetele.

verses.en: And they that understand among the people shall instruct many: yet they shall fall by the sword, and by flame, by captivity, and by spoil, many days.
verses.sm: O e ua popoto i le nuu latou te aʻoaʻoina atu i tagata e toatele; a o aso e tele e pauu ai i latou i le pelu ma le afi, ma le tafeaga, ma le veteina.

verses.en: Now when they shall fall, they shall be holpen with a little help: but many shall cleave to them with flatteries.
verses.sm: A pauu foi i latou, latou te maua se fesoasoani, O se fesoasoani itiiti; a e toatele e pipii atu ia te i latou ma faaoleolega.

verses.en: And some of them of understanding shall fall, to try them, and to purge, and to make them white, even to the time of the end: because it is yet for a time appointed.
verses.sm: E pauu foi nisi o e popoto, e tofotofoina ai i latou, ma faamamaina ai, ma faasinasinaina ai, seia oo i ona po o le juga; aua e lei oo i ona po ua tuupoina.

verses.en: And the king shall do according to his will; and he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god, and shall speak marvellous things against the God of gods, and shall prosper till the indignation be accomplished: for that that is determined shall be done.
verses.sm: O le tupu foi na te faia e tusa ma lona loto, ma faamaualuga o ia e ia, ma faasili ia te ia i atua uma; na te faia upu faasausili i le Atua o atua, e manuia foi o ia seia atoatoa le toasa; auà e faia lava le mea ua tuu i ai le pule.

verses.en: Neither shall he regard the God of his fathers, nor the desire of women, nor regard any god: for he shall magnify himself above all.
verses.sm: Na te le manatu i le Atua o ona tama, na te le manatu i le manao i fafine, na te le manatu foi i se tasi atua; aua e faasilisili o ia e ia i mea uma.

verses.en: But in his estate shall he honour the God of forces: and a god whom his fathers knew not shall he honour with gold, and silver, and with precious stones, and pleasant things.
verses.sm: E ava o ia i le atua o ‘olo i le mea e nofo ai o ia; o le atua foi sa le iloa e ona tama na te ava i ai, ma avatu i ai auro, ma ario, ma maa tàua, atoa ma mea matagofie.

verses.en: Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god, whom he shall acknowledge and increase with glory: and he shall cause them to rule over many, and shall divide the land for gain.
verses.sm: E faia lava lea e ia i ‘olo e sili ona malolosi, i le atua ese, o le e manatua e ia ma faasilisili ona ava i ai; na te tuuina atu foi ia te i latou le pule i tagata e toatele, na te vaevaeina foi le laueleele e maua ai le taui.

verses.en: And at the time of the end shall the king of the south push at him: and the king of the north shall come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, and with horsemen, and with many ships; and he shall enter into the countries, and shall overflow and pass over.
verses.sm: A 00 i ona po o le iuga, ona sii atu lea ia te ia o Je taua e le tupu o le itu i toga; e pei se afa ona oso atu ia te ia o le tupuo le itui matu ma kariota, ma e o tietie i solofanua, atoa ma vaa e tele; na te oo atu foi i nuu, ma lolofi i ai, ma ui ane ai.

verses.en: He shall enter also into the glorious land, and many countries shall be overthrown: but these shall escape out of his hand, even Edom, and Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.
verses.sm: E co atu foi o ia i le nuu matagofie, e faaumatia foi nuu e tele; a e sao nai lona lima o nuu ia, o Etoma, ma Moapi, atoa ma e ua sili i le fanauga a Amoni.

verses.en: He shall stretch forth his hand also upon the countries: and the land of Egypt shall not escape.
verses.sm: Na te faaoo atu lona lima i nuu, e le sao foi le nuu o Aikupito.

verses.en: But he shall have power over the treasures of gold and of silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt: and the Libyans and the Ethiopians shall be at his steps.
verses.sm: A e pwe o ia i oloa, O auro, ma ario atoa ma mea matagofie uma o Aikupito; e mulimuli atu foi ia te ia o Lipua ma Aitiope.

verses.en: But tidings out of the east and out of the north shall trouble him: therefore he shall go forth with great fury to destroy, and utterly to make away many.
verses.sm: A o tala mai sasae, ma le itu i matu e atuatuvale ai o ia; ona alu atu ai lea o ia ma le ita tele ia faaumatia ma fasiotia tagata e toatele.

verses.en: And he shall plant the tabernacles of his palace between the seas in the glorious holy mountain; yet he shall come to his end, and none shall help him.
verses.sm: Na te faatuina fale ie o fona maota i le va o sami, i le mauga matagofie ma le paia; a e oo atu i lona iuga, e leai foi se tasi e fesoasoani ia te ia.
